title: Warm Aerated Resinous French Chinese Cabbage Alsatian Galette
description: A low-fat friendly Alsatian galette featuring stir-fried Chinese cabbage, crispy pastry, and a hint of resinous flavors. Perfect for a cozy dinner or lunch.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and cold butter. Use a pastry blender or your fingertips to work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the chilled dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the dough to a ceramic taigne or a 9-inch (23 cm) round baking dish, trimming the edges to fit.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is tender and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the scallions, lime juice, resinous honey, and crystallized ginger. Cook for an additional minute.
Spoon the cabbage mixture onto one half of the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Sprinkle the black sesame seeds over the cabbage mixture.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the galette with a little bit of water and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the galette for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
